title: Canada Should Reform or Axe Foreign Worker Visa, BC Premier Says
summary: Canada should overhaul or end a program that allows companies to bring in foreign workers, British Columbia’s premier said, adding to a national debate about how Prime Minister Mark Carney should revamp the country’s immigration policy.
